recent.text: And Yanic Konan Niederhäuser will make his sophomore season debut against Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs. The summer after the 2025 draft, Konan Niederhäuser was playing against Wemby at Loyola Marymount University in Westchester. Tyronn Lue was in attendance.
recent.author: Law Murray 🎮
recent.quoted_text: The LA Clippers begin a four-game road trip — and Brandon Ingram (heel/Achilles) and Yanic Konan Niederhäuser (Lisfranc) are both on it. Ingram hasn’t played since the 2026 postseason with the Raptors, and Konan Niederhäuser hasn’t played since March. Both could make their debuts
